element.definition: [HEDIS] The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.
[US Core] The status of the diagnostic report.

[US Core]  A code that classifies the clinical discipline, department or diagnostic service that created the report (e.g. cardiology, biochemistry, hematology, MRI). This is used for searching, sorting and display purposes.
[US Core] The test, panel, report, or note that was ordered.
[HEDIS][US Core] The subject of the report. Usually, but not always, this is a patient. However diagnostic services also perform analyses on specimens collected from a variety of other sources.
[US Core] The healthcare event  (e.g. a patient and healthcare provider interaction) which this DiagnosticReport is about.
[US Core] This is the Datetime or Period when the report or note was written.
[US Core] The diagnostic service that is responsible for issuing the report.
[US Core] Rich text representation of the entire result as issued by the diagnostic service. Multiple formats are allowed but they SHALL be semantically equivalent.
